paite: Leitung leh asung a thil om tengteng TOUPA a ahi a; khovel leh asung a om tengteng toh;
heading: David La / Kumpipa Thupi

paite: Tuipite tung a lei amah muhkhiak ahi a, tuite tung ah amah hihkip ahi.
TOUPA mual ah kua apaitou dia, amun siangthou ah kua ahia dingh ding?
Khut siang leh lungtang siangthou nei a, alungsim thulim lou lam a koih ngei lou a, khem tum a kichiam ngei lou mi.
Ama'n TOUPA kiang a kipan vualzawlna amu ding a, ahondampa Pathian kiang a kipan diktanna leng amu ding hi.
Huai tuh amah zongmi suan ahi. Jakob' Pathian aw, na mel zongte mah. Selah
Kongpite aw, na lutang uh sangsak un; nou tangtawn kongkhakte aw, kikhaisang un! Huchi a thupina Kumpipa ahong luttheihna ding in.
Thupina Kumpipa kua ahia? TOUPA hattak leh thilhihtheitak, TOUPA kidouna a thilhihtheitak, ahi!
Kongpite aw, na lutang uh sangsak unla, ahi, tangtawn kongkhakte aw, kikhaisang un! Huchi a thupina Kumpipa a hong luttheihna ding in.
Hiai thupina Kumpipa kua ahia? Sepaihte' TOUPA amah mah thupina Kumpipa ahi. Selah
